Sourcing Journal # Clarity Systems Secures $4.4 Million Clarity Systems Secures $4.4 Million · Sourcing Journal · Olga Demina/Getty Images Roy Stephen Canivel 2 min read Clarity Systems, an AI powered company that can detect retail fraud by seeing inside returned products without having to open them, said it has just closed a $4.4 million seed round. In a statement, it said the funding was backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. More from WWD Family-Friendly Experiences Are No Longer Optional for Retailers EXCLUSIVE: Reese Cooper Is Putting Down Roots in L.A. EXCLUSIVE: First Look Inside Elysewalker's New Pacific Palisades Flagship [...] Clarity offers a smarter approach, using AI to distinguish legitimate returns from fraudulent ones in seconds, allowing retailers to reduce losses while preserving a seamless customer experience. "Retail fraud has become a professional industry, run at scale against the returns counter and the receiving dock, and most defenses were built for a shoplifting era. We built Clarity to catch it the moment it enters the building," said Andy Ruben, cofounder and CEO of Clarity.
